summary: Smith Micro Software filed an 8-K reporting inducement letter agreements with holders of existing common warrants. Holders agreed to cash exercise 487,349 warrants at a reduced price of $3.35 per share (original $5.20) and received new five-year warrants exercisable at $3.80 per share. Gross proceeds ~$1.6M for working capital. Closing expected ~June 15, 2026. This is a warrant repricing/inducement transaction, not a special situation like restructuring or capital return; it is a routine equity-linked financing.
